settings.feishuConfigDesc1: Keep only the essentials: app credentials, App Token type, App Token, table name, attachment field name, and field mappings.
settings.feishuConfigDesc2: Before saving or testing, authorize the app/bot in the target Bitable base from the top-right permission/config menu. Otherwise table listing and writes will be rejected. The backend resolves the upload node at runtime, so it is no longer shown on the page.
settings.feishuConnectionDesc: Choose Bitable for a native table link. If your token comes from a Wiki page, choose Wiki. Before saving or testing, authorize the app/bot in the target table first; otherwise validation, writes, and attachment uploads will fail.
settings.feishuAppTokenTypeHelp: For native Bitable, paste the App Token from the table URL. For Wiki, paste the Wiki node token and the backend will resolve the writable obj_token automatically.
settings.feishuAppTokenPlaceholder: Native Bitable App Token or Wiki node token
settings.feishuAppTokenHelp: Choose Bitable to paste the App Token from the table URL. Choose Wiki to paste the Wiki node token; the backend resolves it automatically.
settings.feishuTableNameHelp: The target table name must match the actual Feishu table name exactly.
settings.feishuSummaryPrefixHelp: Automatically prepended to the Feishu title. Leave it empty to disable.
settings.feishuAttachmentFieldNameHelp: Uploaded attachments will be written to this table column. Usually this is "Attachments", but you can adjust it to match your actual header.
settings.feishuFieldMappingsHelp: Left side must be an existing Feishu column name copied exactly from the table header.
settings.feishuFieldMappingsDetail: Right side is the internal field name used by the system. Common internal fields: title = original email title, description = original description, summary_title = merged title, summary_content = merged description, llm_content = LLM-generated content.
settings.feishuAttachmentMappingHelp: Attachment files themselves do not need a separate mapping. The test attachments below go through the upload flow directly, and attachment_count is available if you want to store the number of attachments.
settings.feishuTestAttachmentsHelp: The test request automatically attaches a built-in image to verify the full attachment flow end to end.

settings.pauseProcessingHelp: Mail is still collected but nothing is analysed and no credits are spent. Everything already collected waits and resumes automatically when you lift the pause. Useful right after connecting a mailbox with a lot of history, before your filters are tuned.
settings.invoiceOnlyHelp: Fetch only mail whose subject or attachment name names an invoice. The rest is never downloaded, processed or charged. An invoice with a neutral subject (rare) needs the expense app's manual backfill.

expense.pageSubtitle: Turn invoices in your mailbox into ready-to-file reimbursement batches.
expense.enableDesc: Invoices are recognized as mail arrives, not on a schedule. Turning this off stops further recognition; what has already been read is kept.
expense.priceValue: {credits} credit per email holding an invoice (the same one email processing takes)

prefs.title: Recognition and export
prefs.subtitle: These decide which mail is read, and how exported files are named.
prefs.homeCityHelp: Used to tell business travel from everyday spending. Leave blank to infer it from recent invoices.
prefs.filenameTemplateHelp: Decides what each file inside the export archive is called.
prefs.keywordsPlaceholder:
One per line, e.g.
invoice
receipt
prefs.keywordsHelp: Only mail matching a keyword is read as invoices. Empty uses the built-in list.
prefs.sendersPlaceholder: One address or domain per line
prefs.sendersHelp: Leave blank to accept every sender.
prefs.keywordsScope: Where the match is looked for depends on how the mail arrives: on the automatic path only the subject and attachment names are searched; a scan you start yourself also searches the body. Subject and filenames are where a sender says what an email is, and matching on the body alone pulls in every bill that mentions an invoice in its footer.
